Restored to the bytes the .201 dev lane actually applied (content sha c1691130, commit 559ee461a, applied 2026-08-22 20:09:18+00). Commit 7de798a4a had rewritten this applied file in place with 46 lines of reconciliation and five SET NOT NULL that no database ever ran. The delta is re-expressed additively in 0002, minus name/provider which 0001 deliberately relaxes.

CI shape reconciliation requires 0000 to include explicit ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS guards after CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS; the same idempotent reconciliation is expressed additively in 0001 for already-applied deployments.

Both 0000 and 0001 spelled every declared-NOT-NULL column as `ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS <col> <type> NOT NULL`, which cannot reconcile a drifted table that holds rows: PostgreSQL raises 'column "<col>" of relation "<t>" contains null values' and ON_ERROR_STOP=1 kills the Job -- the same deploy-stopping failure the reconciliation exists to prevent, so tests/ci/test_node_migration_shape_reconciliation.py went GREEN while the failure class stayed open. Proven by execution on the .201 dev lane 2026-08-28 against a seeded drifted consumer_flow_windows (only consumer_group, one row): the NOT NULL spelling exits 3 on `topic`; the nullable spelling exits 0 and converges all 14 columns. Rewriting both files is safe because neither was ever applied -- to_regclass() for both relations is ABSENT on the .201 dev lane and onex_application_migration_manifest exists on NO .201 lane, so no content_sha256 is recorded anywhere to conflict with. The corrected delta is re-expressed additively in 0002.

0001 shipped an internal LAN address in a header comment. omnimarket blocks that literal (leaked-literals gate OMN-10580) while its node-migration-vendor-parity-gate requires the omnimarket source file to be byte-identical to this vendored copy, so the address cannot be scrubbed on one side only. The scrub is COMMENT-ONLY -- every executable statement in 0001 is byte-unchanged -- and the recorded content_sha256 is updated with it. Safe: 0001 has only ever been applied by hand (psql -f) to the dev and stability lanes, never through run-forward-migrations.sh, so no onex_application_migration_manifest row records its prior checksum on any lane. The successor named here additionally closes a real gap -- summary is bounded at 2000 chars in ModelWorkEventRow but the column was bare TEXT.
